title: 第一家店開了，做法開始有了主人

lines.text: 一九五八年四月，近鐵布施站附近，「廻る元禄寿司」第一家店開門。

data.prompt: Wide shot of a compact 1958 counter-only restaurant near Fuse Station, one seated customer smiling as she takes a plate from the moving belt, the tight ring of stools showing the small scale, soft daylight from the entrance.

lines.text: 店大約二十坪，只有吧台座位。壽司一盤一盤放上帶子，走到客人面前，客人自己伸手拿。

data.prompt: Medium shot behind a 1958 Osaka moving-belt counter, one chef releasing a prepared plate onto the moving belt and watching it leave his hand, his relieved face above the worktop, gentle light from the shop window.

lines.text: 白石終於把「把盤子送到人面前」這件事，從師傅的手裡交給機器。
這時主要賣一盤四貫、五十日圓，和早年立食壽司不同。

data.prompt: Wide shot from the pavement outside a late-1950s Osaka restaurant, one passerby stopping at a broad plain window to watch a plate travel past inside, blank storefront sign above him, soft afternoon street light.

lines.text: 從店外還看得見輸送帶在轉，路人也會停下來看。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a circa-1960 Japanese restaurant office, one anonymous shop operator studying a simple unmarked drawing of a circulating counter with a concerned expression, a glimpse of ordinary street shops through the window, muted daylight.

lines.text: 別的店若照著做，白石怎麼回應？

data.prompt: Wide shot in an Osaka shopping lane during a later expansion period, one worker raising the shutter of another plain restaurant frontage, the curved counter just visible within, neighboring shop signs left blank, soft morning light.

lines.text: 元祿壽司後來也開進大阪道頓堀，白石自己的版圖在長大。

lines.text: 一九六二年，輸送帶系統以白石個人名義登記為「實用新案」，

data.prompt: Close-up at a 1960s Japanese engineering desk, one technician pointing to a simple blank diagram of a conveyor built into a counter while a separate serving dish sits outside the paper, the device drawing lit by a desk lamp.

lines.text: 登記的日文名稱，直譯是「附輸送帶的料理台」。它保護的是這套裝置的做法，不是壽司本身。

data.prompt: Wide shot inside a 1960s Japanese legal office, one office professional placing a closed unmarked warning envelope beside a simplified conveyor-table sketch, rows of plain folders behind, subdued daylight from a high window.

lines.text: 當時碰上相似的店，它在東京和大阪聘律師及專利代理人，發出警告。

data.prompt: Close-up at a 1960s conveyor dining counter, one delighted diner's face following a single ceramic dish as it glides past, the unmistakable moving route just below the face, a soft pool of light from the shop window.

lines.text: 那段日子，提到迴轉壽司，幾乎就是提到元祿壽司。

data.prompt: Wide shot of an ordinary late-1960s Osaka street, one pedestrian stopping beneath a small blank restaurant sign while the shop's circulating counter is visible deep inside, most of the street continuing beyond it, overcast daylight.

lines.text: 法律能守住裝置，怎麼讓更多人看見這種店？

data.prompt: Wide shot of a 1970 Osaka exhibition forecourt, one visitor turning from a plain pavilion aisle toward a temporary food counter in the distance, simple hanging bunting and an unsigned entrance, soft open-air daylight.

lines.text: 下一站，是開場的萬博會場。

data.prompt: Medium shot in a 1970 Osaka restaurant office, one operator opening a plain invitation envelope above an unmarked exhibition floor sketch, his alert face and the opened flap nearest the viewer, gentle window light.

lines.text: 地方商工會議所邀請東大阪業者，

data.prompt: Wide shot beside a 1970 exhibition station walkway in Osaka, one passenger leaving the raised platform and walking toward a temporary unsigned restaurant entrance below, the clear footpath between them, hazy daylight.

lines.text: 白石把店開在會場單軌列車西口站前。

data.prompt: Medium shot behind a 1970 temporary dining counter, one kitchen worker quickly filling a plain serving tub at a crowded preparation bench, his tense face above a row of waiting tubs, soft overhead pavilion light.

lines.text: 客人愈來愈多，忙到無法按魚料慢慢出餐；
於是把三百日圓的握壽司套組裝進壽司桶，放上輸送帶。

data.prompt: Close-up at a 1970 exhibition counter, one cook using both hands to settle a plain wooden sushi tub securely onto a moving conveyor, a smaller serving dish held back on the work surface, diffused pavilion light.

lines.text: 這不是首店五十日圓四貫的餐盤。
報導記下博志對萬博店的回憶：蝦要剝，海苔要剪，備料全靠人手。

data.prompt: Wide shot along a 1970 exhibition dining counter, one worker withdrawing his hands as a filled plain tub travels toward a waiting seat, the moving route cutting through the busy space, soft light from the pavilion roof.

lines.text: 原先減少遞盤人手的機器，此時接住了會場客流。
